errors.msg: fatal: -L requires a range and a file
errors.why: Line-range logging needs both the range and the path, joined by a colon.

fix.n: Numbers, colon, then the path.
Or name a function instead of line numbers.

errors.msg: fatal: Invalid pathspec magic in ':(exclude)'
errors.why: The pathspec syntax is wrong or unquoted, so the shell mangled it.

fix.n: Quote the pathspec so the shell leaves it alone.
The short form needs quoting too.

errors.msg: fatal: cannot describe '<hash>'  (no annotated tags)
errors.why: describe reads annotated tags by default, and only lightweight ones exist.

fix.n: Includes lightweight tags in the search.
Annotated tags are the right kind for releases.

errors.msg: fatal: no tag message?
errors.why: An annotated tag was requested without a message and the editor closed empty.

fix.n: Pass the message inline.
Or make a lightweight tag when no message is wanted.

errors.msg: No local changes to save
errors.why: There is nothing modified or staged, so a stash would hold nothing.

fix.n: Confirms the tree is clean.
Untracked files need -u; without it they are not stashed.

errors.msg: fatal: '<ref>' is not a stash-like commit
errors.why: The reference given is not a stash entry.

fix.n: Shows valid entries such as stash@{0}.
Quote it in shells where braces expand.

errors.msg: fatal: clean.requireForce defaults to true and neither -i, -n, nor -f given
errors.why: Git refuses to delete untracked files without an explicit instruction.

fix.n: Rehearse first; this lists what would go.
Then delete. There is no undo, because Git never had these files.

errors.msg: error: the following file has local modifications:  (use --cached to keep the file, or -f to force removal)
errors.why: Removing a file with uncommitted edits would discard them.

fix.n: Stop tracking it but keep the file and its edits.
Delete it and the edits, when that is genuinely what you want.

errors.msg: fatal: destination exists, source=<a>, destination=<b>
errors.why: The target path already exists, so the move would overwrite it.

fix.n: Force it when replacing is intended.
Check what is at the destination first; case-only renames need -f too.

errors.msg: fatal: could not resolve --source=<ref>
errors.why: The commit, branch, or tag named as the source does not resolve.

fix.n: Confirms the reference exists.
Remote branches need the remote prefix.

errors.msg: fatal: a branch is expected, got commit '<hash>'
errors.why: switch works on branches; a bare commit needs an explicit detach.

fix.n: States that standing on a commit is intended.
Or make a branch there so commits have a home.

errors.msg: fatal: this worktree is not sparse
errors.why: A sparse-checkout command ran in a repository where the feature is off.

fix.n: Turn it on first.
Then choose the paths you want on disk.

errors.msg: warning: rerere.enabled is not set; nothing recorded
errors.why: Conflict resolutions are only remembered when the feature is switched on.

fix.n: Records resolutions from now on.
Shows what has been recorded once it is running.

errors.msg: error: Repository lacks these prerequisite commits:
errors.why: The bundle is incremental and this repository lacks the commits it builds on.

fix.n: Lists exactly which commits are required.
Ask for a complete bundle when the prerequisites are missing.

errors.msg: git: 'send-email' is not a git command.
errors.why: send-email ships separately from core Git on most platforms.

fix.n: Install the package that provides it.
Or produce the patch and send it by any means.

errors.msg: error: Load key "<path>": No such file or directory  fatal: failed to write commit object
errors.why: Signing is configured with a key file that does not exist.

fix.n: SSH signing points at the public key.
Or turn signing off until the key is in place.

errors.msg: git: 'credential-manager' is not a git command
errors.why: The configured credential helper is not installed on this machine.

fix.n: Shows what is configured.
Switch to a helper this machine has, or install the intended one.

errors.msg: error: unable to read askpass response from '<program>'
errors.why: Git tried to prompt through a helper program that failed or is missing.

fix.n: Fall back to a terminal prompt.
Clear a stale helper path.

errors.msg: fatal: unable to access '<url>': error:1408F10B:SSL routines:ssl3_get_record:wrong version number
errors.why: Something is speaking plain HTTP to an HTTPS port, usually a misconfigured proxy.

fix.n: Clear a proxy pointing at the wrong scheme.
Confirms whether TLS works outside Git at all.

errors.msg: remote: error: Commits must have verified signatures.
errors.why: A ruleset requires signed commits and one in the push is unsigned.

fix.n: Finds the unsigned commit.
Re-sign the range, then force-push if the branch is yours.

errors.msg: HTTP 409: Conflict
errors.why: The resource changed since you read it, or the repository is empty.

fix.n: Fetch the current sha and send it with the update.
An empty repository returns 409 for content operations until the first commit.

errors.msg: HTTP 410: Issues are disabled for this repo
errors.why: The feature was switched off for the repository.

fix.n: Enable issues, wikis, or projects as needed.
Confirms the state before scripting against it.

errors.msg: HTTP 401: Bad credentials
errors.why: The token is wrong, revoked, or expired.

fix.n: Shows whether the stored token still authenticates.
Re-issue it; fine-grained tokens expire on a schedule by design.

errors.msg: Invalid workflow file: Unrecognized named-value: 'env'
errors.why: An expression referenced a context that is not available where it was used.

fix.n: job-level if cannot read env; use the github context.
The error names the line, which is usually enough.

errors.msg: The workflow is not valid: job 'a' and job 'b' are in a dependency cycle
errors.why: Two jobs list each other in needs, which can never resolve.

fix.n: Dependencies must form a one-way chain.
Sketch the graph; cycles usually come from a copied block.

errors.msg: Failed to initialize container <image>: health check failed
errors.why: A service container never became ready, so the job aborted.

fix.n: Give the service a health check and enough retries.
The container log usually names the real startup failure.

errors.msg: Error: This version of actions/download-artifact is not compatible with artifacts uploaded by v3
errors.why: Artifact versions must match between upload and download.

fix.n: Use the same major version on both sides.
Check which version the uploading job used.

errors.msg: Cache not found for input keys: <key>
errors.why: No cache matches that key, which is normal on the first run or after a lockfile change.

fix.n: A prefix fallback reuses a near-match instead of starting cold.
Shows what is stored and how large it is.

errors.msg: Waiting for approval from required reviewers
errors.why: The job targets a protected environment and is paused until someone approves.

fix.n: Shows who can approve and the pending deployment.
Adjust the reviewer list if the gate is in the wrong place.

errors.msg: CodeQL did not detect any code written in languages supported by CodeQL
errors.why: The scan found nothing to analyse, usually a build that produced no compiled output.

fix.n: Name the languages explicitly in the workflow.
The managed setup handles build detection for you.

errors.msg: Dependabot cannot update <package> to a non-vulnerable version
errors.why: No fixed release exists yet, or your constraints forbid the one that does.

fix.n: Shows the alert and the patched version if there is one.
Or apply a workaround and dismiss the alert with a reason.

errors.msg: An error occurred setting up the container: failed to build
errors.why: The devcontainer image failed to build, so the environment never started.

fix.n: The build log names the failing step.
Test the same Dockerfile locally before pushing the change.

errors.msg: Domain does not resolve to the GitHub Pages server
errors.why: The DNS record is missing, wrong, or has not propagated yet.

fix.n: Should show the Pages address or your user subdomain.
Re-check after DNS propagates, then enable HTTPS.

errors.msg: Certificate not yet issued for <domain>
errors.why: The certificate is still being provisioned after a DNS change.

fix.n: Enforce HTTPS becomes available once issuance completes.
A wrong record is the usual reason it never completes.

errors.msg: HTTP 422: Validation Failed  asset with this name already exists
errors.why: That filename is already attached to the release.

fix.n: Remove the old one first.
Or overwrite it in one step.

errors.msg: release not found
errors.why: The release does not exist, or the tag was never pushed.

fix.n: Push the tag, then create the release from it.
Shows what exists on the server.

errors.msg: Could not resolve to a ProjectV2 with the number <n>
errors.why: The project number belongs to another owner, or the token lacks project scope.

fix.n: Lists the projects you can see.
Projects need their own scope.

errors.msg: Cannot add issue to a closed milestone
errors.why: Closed milestones do not accept new items.

fix.n: Lists milestones and their state.
Or attach the issue to the current one.

errors.msg: The repository <name> already exists on this account.
errors.why: That name is taken by another repository you own, possibly archived.

fix.n: Find the holder, including archived repositories.
Pick a free name, or rename the old repository first.

errors.msg: You don't have admin rights to transfer this repository
errors.why: Transfers require admin on the source and permission to create in the target.

fix.n: Confirms your role.
Organizations can restrict who may create or receive repositories.

errors.msg: User is not provisioned in this organization
errors.why: An identity-managed organization only admits users its provider has provisioned.

fix.c: Ask an owner to check the identity provider
fix.n: Membership is granted upstream, not on GitHub.
Confirms current membership.

errors.msg: warning: <path> has different normalization forms
errors.why: macOS stores certain accented names differently, so the same name can appear twice.

fix.n: Normalises names on macOS, which is the default in modern Git.
Confirms the phantom rename disappears.

errors.msg: warning: commit message did not conform to UTF-8
errors.why: The message contains bytes that are not valid UTF-8, usually from a terminal in another codepage.

fix.n: Declares the encoding you actually use.
Rewrite the message from a UTF-8 capable terminal.

errors.msg: error: cannot rebase: Your index contains uncommitted changes.
errors.why: Rebase rewrites commits and refuses to run with staged work in the way.

fix.n: Shelve everything, rebase, then pop.
Or commit it; you can fold the commit in during the rebase.

errors.msg: warning: 3 lines add whitespace errors.
errors.why: The patch introduces trailing whitespace or space-before-tab.

fix.n: Cleans the damage while applying.
Catches the same problem in your own work before committing.

errors.msg: error: promisor remote not found
errors.why: A partial clone lost the remote it fetches missing objects from.

fix.n: Restores the marker on the remote.
Or reclone; partial clones depend on that remote staying configured.

errors.msg: fatal: unknown value for config 'protocol.version': 2
errors.why: The server or an intermediary does not speak protocol v2.

fix.n: Falls back for one command.
Set it permanently only if the server genuinely cannot upgrade.

errors.msg: fatal: <branch> is already used by worktree at <path>
errors.why: One branch cannot be checked out in two worktrees at once.

fix.n: Names the worktree holding it.
Detached checkouts of the same commit are allowed.

errors.msg: error: Untracked working tree file '<file>' would be overwritten by merge.  (applying a stash)
errors.why: The stash carries an untracked file you have since recreated.

fix.n: Move yours aside, apply the stash, then reconcile.
Shows what the stash will write before you apply it.

errors.msg: HEAD detached at <hash>  (inside a submodule)
errors.why: Submodules are pinned to a commit, so they always check out detached.

fix.n: Branch inside the submodule before committing there.
Then record the new pointer in the parent repository.

errors.msg: Skipping object checkout, Git LFS is not installed.
errors.why: Pointer files were checked out literally because the filters are missing.

fix.c: git lfs install && git lfs pull
fix.n: Install the filters, then fetch real content.
A short text file starting with version https://git-lfs is a pointer, not your data.

errors.msg: no pull requests found for branch "<branch>"
errors.why: gh looked for a pull request from the current branch and found none.

fix.n: Open one, or pass a number to act on an existing pull request.
Finds it if the pull request exists but is closed.

errors.msg: GraphQL: Could not resolve to a Repository with the name '<owner>/<repo>'
errors.why: The repository does not exist, was renamed, or is invisible to this account.

fix.n: Confirms which account you are acting as.
A 404 for a private repository looks identical to one that never existed.

errors.msg: X could not create alias: "<name>" is already an alias
errors.why: That alias name is taken.

fix.n: Shows the current set.
Remove it first, or choose another name.

errors.msg: fatal: alias loop detected: expansion of '<name>' does not terminate
errors.why: An alias expands to itself, directly or through a chain.

fix.n: Lists every alias so you can see the cycle.
Remove or rewrite the offending one.

errors.msg: fatal: cannot handle <text> as a builtin
errors.why: The alias runs shell syntax without being marked as a shell alias.

fix.n: The leading exclamation mark makes it a shell alias.
Check what is stored; quoting is usually the problem.

errors.msg: error: There was a problem with the editor '<editor>'.
errors.why: The editor exited with a failure status, so Git discarded the message.

fix.n: Without --wait the editor returns immediately and looks like a failure.
Bypass the editor while you sort the configuration out.

errors.msg: WARNING: terminal is not fully functional
errors.why: The TERM value is unknown, so the pager cannot draw properly.

fix.n: Set a value the environment understands.
Or skip the pager entirely in that environment.

errors.msg: error: cannot run <pager>: No such file or directory  (custom diff pager)
errors.why: A diff pager such as delta is configured but not installed here.

fix.n: Falls back to the built-in pager.
Or install the tool the configuration expects.

errors.msg: This message is displayed because 'merge.tool' is not configured.
errors.why: No merge tool is set, so Git cannot launch one.

fix.n: Name the tool, then define its cmd.
Resolving conflicts by hand in an editor is always available.

errors.msg: Launch '<tool>' [Y/n]?
errors.why: difftool asks before each file, which is tedious across a large diff.

fix.n: Stops the prompt permanently.
Or skip it for one invocation.

errors.msg: fatal: no such path '<path>' in HEAD
errors.why: The path does not exist in the commit you are blaming, usually after a rename or delete.

fix.n: Finds when it disappeared.
Blame the commit before the deletion.

errors.msg: fatal: --follow requires exactly one pathspec
errors.why: Rename following works for one path at a time.

fix.n: Run it per file.
Drop --follow when you need several paths at once.

errors.msg: bisect run failed: exit code 128 from '<command>' is < 0 or >= 128
errors.why: The test script returned a status bisect reserves for its own signalling.

fix.n: Use 0 for good and 1 for bad; 125 means untestable.
Have the script normalise its exit codes before returning.

errors.msg: git grep found no matches (exit status 1)
errors.why: Not an error: grep signals absence with a non-zero status, which stops strict scripts.

fix.n: Neutralise the status when absence is acceptable.
Count form when a script wants a number rather than a status.

errors.msg: fatal: prefix must end with /
errors.why: git archive requires the prefix to be a directory path.

fix.n: Add the trailing slash.
Or omit the prefix entirely.

errors.msg: fatal: unable to update url base from redirection
errors.why: The server redirected to a different repository path than the one requested.

fix.n: Allows the redirect explicitly.
Better, store the destination so no redirect is needed.

errors.msg: fatal: clone of '<url>' into submodule path '<path>' failed
errors.why: A submodule clone failed, usually authentication or a moved URL.

fix.n: Refreshes URLs from .gitmodules into the live config.
Retry after fixing access to that submodule.

errors.msg: error: atomic push failed, no refs updated
errors.why: One ref in an atomic push was rejected, so all of them were refused together.

fix.n: Push refs individually to see which one is refused.
Or drop atomicity when partial success is acceptable.

errors.msg: warning: There are too many unreachable loose objects; run 'git prune' to remove them.
errors.why: Rewrites and resets left many orphaned objects behind.

fix.n: Removes them once you are sure nothing needed is unreachable.
The reflog holds them; expiring it first is what actually frees the space.

errors.msg: old mode 100644  new mode 100755
errors.why: Only the executable bit changed, which is real to Git but usually accidental.

fix.n: Stops Git tracking mode changes on filesystems that fake them.
Or set the bit deliberately when it matters.

errors.msg: The following paths are ignored  (a negation cannot re-include inside an excluded directory)
errors.why: Once a directory is excluded, Git never descends into it, so a negation inside cannot match.

fix.n: Exclude the contents rather than the directory itself.
Names the rule that actually wins.

errors.msg: warning: core.excludesFile points to a file that does not exist
errors.why: The global ignore file is configured but missing.

fix.n: Point it somewhere real.
Create the file, then add your personal rules.

errors.msg: error: external filter '<name>' is not available
errors.why: A .gitattributes filter names a program this machine does not have.

fix.n: Shows what the filter expects to run.
Makes the filter optional so checkouts still work.

errors.msg: warning: commit <hash> has a future date
errors.why: A commit timestamp is ahead of the current clock, so ordering looks wrong.

fix.n: Shows both dates so you can see which is off.
Fix the machine clock; timedatectl set-ntp true on Linux.

errors.msg: error: unable to write file <path>: Permission denied  (Windows, file in use)
errors.why: Another process holds the file open, commonly an antivirus scanner or an editor.

fix.n: Confirms which paths cannot be written.

fix.c: Exclude the repository from real-time scanning
fix.n: The usual cure on Windows, and it also fixes slowness.

errors.msg: error: unable to unlink old '<file>': Invalid argument  (inside a synced folder)
errors.why: A cloud sync client is holding or rewriting files while Git works on them.

fix.n: Then retry the Git operation.
Better, keep working repositories outside synced folders.

errors.msg: Visual Studio: Git failed with a fatal error. Authentication failed for '<url>'
errors.why: Visual Studio reuses the Windows credential store, and the entry there is stale.

fix.n: Delete the git:https://github.com entry and sign in again.
The command-line equivalent of the same cleanup.

errors.msg: Exception caught during execution of add command  org.eclipse.jgit.api.errors.JGitInternalException
errors.why: The IDE's own Git implementation hit a locked index, usually alongside a command-line operation.

fix.n: Confirm no operation is mid-flight.
Remove the stale lock once nothing is running.

errors.msg: SourceTree: The embedded Git version is out of date
errors.why: The bundled Git is older than the repository features in use.

fix.c: Tools -> Options -> Git -> Use System Git
fix.n: Point the client at your installed Git.
Check the system version is the newer one first.

errors.msg: Android Studio: No version control systems are configured for this project
errors.why: The IDE has not been told the project folder is a repository.

fix.n: Confirms Git sees it as a repository.
Point the IDE at Git for the project root.

errors.msg: Xcode: Source control is disabled for this project
errors.why: Xcode's source control integration is switched off, or the repository is outside the project root.

fix.n: Turn the integration on.
Confirms where the repository root actually is.

errors.msg: hudson.plugins.git.GitException: Failed to fetch from <url>
errors.why: The Jenkins agent could not authenticate or reach the remote.

fix.n: Run it as the Jenkins user to reproduce the failure directly.
Attach a deploy key or token scoped to that repository.

errors.msg: Permission denied (publickey).  Please make sure you have the correct access rights (CircleCI)
errors.why: The CI project has no valid checkout key for the repository.

fix.n: Add or rotate the checkout key.
Reproduces the same handshake the runner performs.

errors.msg: fatal: could not read Username  (Azure Pipelines checkout)
errors.why: The pipeline checkout has no credential for a second repository.

fix.n: Lets later steps reuse the checkout credential.
Declare the extra repository so the agent authenticates for it.

errors.msg: Failed to download module: error downloading '<url>': /usr/bin/git exited with 128
errors.why: Terraform shelled out to Git for a module source and Git failed.

fix.n: Reproduces the failure without Terraform.
Supply credentials for private module sources in automation.

errors.msg: fatal: [host]: FAILED! => {"msg": "Failed to checkout branch <name>"}
errors.why: The Ansible git module could not check out that reference on the target host.

fix.n: Confirms the branch exists and is reachable from that host.
First contact over SSH fails without a known host entry.

errors.msg: error: failed to authenticate when downloading repository  attempted ssh-agent authentication
errors.why: Cargo used SSH and found no usable key in the agent.

fix.n: Lists the keys the agent currently holds.
In .cargo/config.toml, this makes Cargo use your Git and its credentials.

errors.msg: Bundler::GitError: Git error: command `git fetch` in directory <path> has failed.
errors.why: Bundler's cached Git source could not update.

fix.n: Clears a stale local override.
Remove the cached clone and let Bundler fetch again.

errors.msg: [ERROR] Failed to execute goal ... scm:checkout  Cannot checkout: <url>
errors.why: The Maven build tried a Git checkout it could not authenticate.

fix.n: Confirms access from the build machine.
Store the credential where Maven expects it rather than in the POM.

errors.msg: Unable to load the service index for source <url>  401 (Unauthorized)
errors.why: The package feed rejected the credential, commonly a GitHub Packages token without read:packages.

fix.n: Add the scope.
Store the credential for that feed.

errors.msg: error: failed to resolve dependencies  Couldn't get the list of tags
errors.why: Swift Package Manager could not read the repository's tags, usually access or a moved URL.

fix.n: Confirms the tags are visible to you.
Clears a stale resolution cache and retries.

errors.msg: [!] Error installing <pod>  fatal: could not read Username for 'https://github.com'
errors.why: CocoaPods fetched a private pod source with no credential available.

fix.n: Let the keychain answer for it.
Refresh the spec repo once credentials work.

errors.msg: Error: Cannot determine base for affected commands: fatal: bad revision 'origin/main'
errors.why: The monorepo tool compared against a ref the shallow CI checkout never fetched.

fix.n: Affected calculations need history and the base branch.
Or fetch just the base ref the tool compares against.

errors.msg: No new changesets found  (release workflow exits without publishing)
errors.why: The release tool found no changeset files, so there is nothing to version.

fix.n: Add a changeset describing the change before merging.
Confirms whether the branch carries any releasable work.

errors.msg: There is no previous release, the next release version is 1.0.0
errors.why: Not an error: the tool found no prior tag and is starting the version history.

fix.n: Confirms whether tags exist but were not fetched.
Release tooling needs the full tag history to compute the next version.

errors.msg: pre-commit not found. Did you forget to activate your virtualenv?
errors.why: The hook script calls a tool missing from this environment.

fix.n: Install it and reinstall the hooks.
Bypass once while you fix the environment.

errors.msg: No staged files match any configured task
errors.why: Nothing staged matches the configured patterns, so the tool had nothing to run.

fix.n: Shows what is staged and whether the pattern should match.
Stage the files the task expects.

errors.msg: subject may not be empty [subject-empty]  type may not be empty [type-empty]
errors.why: The message does not match the enforced convention, usually missing the type prefix.

fix.n: Type, colon, space, then the subject.
Fix the last message rather than adding a second commit.

errors.msg: git-crypt: error: file not encrypted: <path>
errors.why: An encrypted-path file was committed before git-crypt was unlocked.

fix.n: Unlock the repository first.
Lists which paths should be encrypted and which are not.

errors.msg: Failed to get the data key required to decrypt the SOPS file
errors.why: No key available here can decrypt the secrets file.

fix.n: Reproduces the failure with the underlying tool.

fix.c: Check the KMS or age key is present
fix.n: Decryption needs a key this machine or runner actually holds.

errors.msg: Aborting: refusing to run on a repo with a working tree
errors.why: BFG expects a bare mirror clone, not a working checkout.

fix.n: Clone bare, run the tool, then push.
filter-repo is the maintained alternative and gives clearer errors.

errors.msg: Author: <user> not defined in authors file
errors.why: The SVN import found a username with no mapping to a Git identity.

fix.n: Add the missing mapping.
Restart the import with the completed file.

errors.msg: hg-fast-export.sh: command not found
errors.why: The Mercurial conversion script is not installed or not on PATH.

fix.n: Fetch the tool, then call its script by path.
Mercurial itself must also be installed for the export to run.

errors.msg: codespace not found or not running
errors.why: The codespace is stopped or was deleted.

fix.n: Shows state; stopped codespaces must be started first.
Start it, then connect.

errors.msg: Error: Failed to install feature '<feature>'
errors.why: A devcontainer feature failed during the image build.

fix.n: The build log names the failing feature and step.
Pin the feature version, or remove it and install in postCreateCommand.

errors.msg: This job is waiting for a runner from '<label>' to come online
errors.why: No runner with that label is available to take the job.

fix.n: Check the self-hosted runner is online and carries the label.
Or move the job to a hosted runner.

errors.msg: Canceling since a higher priority waiting request for '<group>' exists
errors.why: A newer run in the same concurrency group superseded this one.

fix.n: Expected behaviour when cancel-in-progress is on.
Turn it off for deploys that must never be interrupted.

errors.msg: The job was not started because recent account payments have failed
errors.why: Actions is blocked because billing is unpaid or the spending limit is reached.

fix.n: Clear the payment or raise the limit.
Moving open work to a public repository sidesteps the limit entirely.

errors.msg: fatal: repository '../<name>.git' does not exist
errors.why: The submodule uses a relative URL that resolves against a different parent than expected.

fix.n: Shows the recorded relative path.
Recomputes absolute URLs from the current remote.

errors.msg: Resolving deltas: 100% (done) but the command never returns
errors.why: Delta resolution finished and Git is now writing files, which is disk-bound on huge trees.

fix.n: Speeds later operations on large working trees.
Avoids materialising history you do not need.

errors.msg: Updating files: 100% (12000/12000), done.  (taking minutes)
errors.why: Every file write is being scanned, which multiplies checkout time on Windows.

fix.c: Exclude the repository folder from real-time scanning
fix.n: The single biggest Windows speed fix.
Reduces filesystem round trips on Windows.

errors.msg: warning: Cannot merge binary files  (custom merge driver not defined)
errors.why: A .gitattributes entry names a merge driver that is not configured here.

fix.n: Shows whether the driver exists on this machine.
Define it, or remove the attribute if it is unused.

errors.msg: CHANGELOG.md merged with duplicated entries
errors.why: A union merge keeps both sides, which duplicates lines that were meant to be one.

fix.n: Review the merged file; union never reports a conflict, so it never asks.

fix.c: Edit and commit the corrected file
fix.n: Union suits append-only lists, not files where order matters.

errors.msg: warning: disabling cone pattern matching  (non-cone patterns present)
errors.why: Non-cone sparse patterns disable the fast sparse index.

fix.n: Cone mode is faster and covers most needs.
Shows which patterns forced the fallback.

errors.msg: jq: error: null has no keys
errors.why: The API returned no data for that path, so the filter had nothing to read.

fix.n: Run it without --jq to see the raw response first.
The question mark tolerates an empty or null result.

errors.msg: only 30 results returned
errors.why: The endpoint paginates and the request took only the first page.

fix.n: Follows every page.
Fewer round trips for large lists.

errors.msg: We couldn't deliver this payload: Service Timeout
errors.why: The receiving endpoint did not answer inside the delivery window.

fix.n: Inspect and redeliver the exact payload.
Webhook handlers must acknowledge fast and process afterwards.

errors.msg: Resource not accessible by personal access token
errors.why: The token type cannot reach that resource; some endpoints require a GitHub App installation token.

fix.n: Confirms what an installation can actually see.
Fine-grained permissions are granted per installation, not per user.

errors.msg: Dependabot could not authenticate to the private registry
errors.why: Dependabot has its own secret store, separate from Actions secrets.

fix.n: Add the credential there as well.
Declare the registry and reference the Dependabot secret.

errors.msg: Secret <name> is not available in this codespace
errors.why: Codespaces secrets are granted per repository and must be selected for this one.

fix.n: Grant the secret to this repository.
Lists what the codespace can actually see.

errors.msg: You must enable two-factor authentication to access this organization
errors.why: The organization requires two-factor authentication and your account has none.

fix.n: Enable it, then rejoin or refresh access.
Access is restored once the requirement is satisfied.

errors.msg: fatal: --orphan is incompatible with -b
errors.why: Those two ways of creating a branch cannot be combined.

fix.n: The modern form, which needs no extra flag.
The older equivalent; pick one form, not both.

errors.msg: fatal: Cannot force update the current branch.
errors.why: A branch cannot be moved with -f while it is checked out.

fix.n: Moves the current branch, which is the supported way.
Or step off it first.

errors.msg: fatal: Invalid branch name: '<name>'
errors.why: The new branch name breaks the naming rules, often a leading dash or a space.

fix.n: Validates a name before you use it.
Rename with a name Git accepts.

errors.msg: fatal: Refusing to fetch into branch 'refs/heads/main' checked out at '<path>'
errors.why: Fetching directly into a checked-out branch would desynchronise the working tree.

fix.n: Works only when that branch is not checked out anywhere.
From the branch itself, pull is the correct command.

errors.msg: ! [rejected] <name> -> <name> (fetch first)
errors.why: The remote branch moved after you last fetched.

fix.n: See what arrived before deciding.
Replay your work on top, then push.

errors.msg: warning: reflog of 'HEAD' references pruned commits
errors.why: The reflog names commits that garbage collection has already removed.

fix.n: Clears the stale entries.
Then repack; the entries were pointing at nothing recoverable.

errors.msg: dangling blob <hash>
errors.why: An object exists that nothing references, usually staged-then-reset content.

fix.n: Inspect it; this is often exactly the work you thought was lost.
Removes it once you are certain it is not wanted.

errors.msg: broken link from commit <a> to tree <b>
errors.why: A commit points at a tree the repository no longer holds.

fix.n: Shows the extent of the damage.
Reclone from a healthy remote rather than repairing object by object.

errors.msg: error: index-pack died of signal 9
errors.why: The unpack process was killed, almost always by the out-of-memory killer.

fix.n: Caps memory during packing.
A smaller transfer avoids the peak entirely.

errors.msg: sign_and_send_pubkey: no mutual signature algorithm
errors.why: The client and server share no acceptable signature algorithm, typical with an old RSA key.

fix.n: Generate a modern key and add it to your account.
A short-term workaround in ~/.ssh/config while you migrate.

errors.msg: Received disconnect from <host>: Too many authentication failures
errors.why: The agent offered too many keys before the right one.

fix.n: Offer exactly one key.
Set it per host in ~/.ssh/config so it stops recurring.

errors.msg: WARNING: REMOTE HOST IDENTIFICATION HAS CHANGED!
errors.why: The server's host key differs from the one recorded, which SSH treats as serious.

fix.n: Remove the stale entry after verifying the new key is genuine.
Never accept a changed key without checking the published values.

errors.msg: Unverified: The signing key is not known to GitHub
errors.why: The commit is signed, but the public key is not on the account.

fix.c: Settings -> SSH and GPG keys -> New signing key
fix.n: Add the public key as a signing key, not only an authentication key.
Confirms which key made the signature.

errors.msg: Unverified: This commit was created without a signature
errors.why: Vigilant mode marks every unsigned commit, including old ones.

fix.c: Settings -> SSH and GPG keys -> Vigilant mode
fix.n: Turn it off if the badges are noise rather than policy.
Or sign consistently from now on.

errors.msg: You have triggered an abuse detection mechanism.
errors.why: The request pattern looked automated and aggressive.

fix.n: A second or two between writes avoids it entirely.
Let the CLI pace pagination rather than looping requests yourself.

errors.msg: refusing to allow a Personal Access Token to create or update workflow without `workflow` scope
errors.why: Pushing changes to files under .github/workflows needs an extra scope.

fix.n: Adds the scope to the existing login.
Retry; the same push succeeds once the token carries it.

errors.msg: Error: The operation was canceled.  (job exceeded timeout-minutes)
errors.why: The job ran past its allowed time and was stopped.

fix.n: Raise it if the work genuinely takes that long.
Find the step that hung; a wedged step is more common than slow work.

errors.msg: The <image> runner image is deprecated and will be removed
errors.why: The runner label points at an image being retired.

fix.n: Track the current image.
Or pin a supported version explicitly and plan the upgrade.

errors.msg: Error: Unable to find Node version '<version>' for platform linux
errors.why: That exact runtime version is not available for the runner platform.

fix.n: A range resolves to the newest matching release.
Keeps the workflow and local development on one source of truth.

errors.msg: Warning: Cache save failed: Unable to reserve cache with key <key>, another job may be creating this cache
errors.why: Two jobs raced to save the same cache key.

fix.n: Make the key unique per job dimension.
The build is unaffected; one job simply loses the race to write.

errors.msg: Error: Artifact name is not valid: <name>. Contains the following character: Double quote
errors.why: Artifact names cannot contain characters that are illegal in file paths.

fix.n: Build names from safe values only.
Matrix values often contain them, which is the usual cause.

errors.msg: Error: The environment url is not a valid URL
errors.why: The deployment URL output was empty or malformed.

fix.n: Emit a complete URL including the scheme.
Drop the url field when there is nothing meaningful to link.

errors.msg: Error: Deployment request failed: another deployment is in progress
errors.why: Two Pages deployments overlapped.

fix.n: Serialise Pages deploys so they queue instead of colliding.
Check for a run still in flight.

errors.msg: Release is a draft and cannot be downloaded
errors.why: Draft releases are visible only to maintainers and serve no assets publicly.

fix.n: Publish it.
Confirms the state before debugging download links.

errors.msg: Some labels could not be transferred
errors.why: Labels that do not exist in the target repository are dropped during a transfer.

fix.n: Create the missing labels first if they matter.
Then transfer; the rest of the issue moves intact.

errors.msg: CODEOWNERS errors: <line> is not a valid owner
errors.why: An owner entry is misspelled, not a member, or lacks repository access.

fix.n: GitHub lists every syntax error with its line number.
Teams need the organization prefix, and users must have write access.

errors.msg: Changes must be made through a pull request.
errors.why: A ruleset blocks direct pushes to that branch, including for administrators.

fix.c: git switch -c fix/<topic> && gh pr create
fix.n: Use the flow the rule expects.
Add yourself only if the rule is genuinely wrong for this repository.

errors.msg: Pull request was removed from the merge queue
errors.why: The pull request failed its checks against the queued result, so the queue ejected it.

fix.n: Shows what failed once merged with the ones ahead.
Update the branch, fix the failure, and requeue.

errors.msg: Auto-merge is not enabled for this repository
errors.why: The repository setting that allows auto-merge is switched off.

fix.n: Enable it once.
Then it works per pull request.

errors.msg: Squash merging is not allowed on this repository
errors.why: The repository permits only the merge methods its settings enable.

fix.n: Enable the method you want to use.
Or use a method the repository allows.

errors.msg: Making this repository private will detach all public forks
errors.why: Public forks cannot follow a repository into private visibility.

fix.n: See how many forks are affected before deciding.
Proceed knowing the forks become independent repositories.

errors.msg: The repository name you entered does not match
errors.why: Deletion requires typing the full owner and repository name exactly.

fix.n: The CLI asks for the same confirmation.
Archiving is usually the better answer and is reversible.

errors.msg: Import failed: unable to access the source repository
errors.why: The importer could not read the source, usually credentials or an unsupported protocol.

fix.n: Clone locally, then push --mirror into the new repository.
Create the target empty first.

errors.msg: remote: warning: File <name> is 63.00 MB; this is larger than GitHub's recommended maximum file size of 50.00 MB
errors.why: A warning, not a rejection: the push succeeds but the repository is heading somewhere painful.

fix.n: Route large files to LFS before they become history.
Or ship build outputs as release assets instead.

errors.msg: Rewriting history will break every existing clone and fork
errors.why: A force-push after a rewrite leaves everyone else on incompatible history.

fix.n: Confirm the rewrite is genuinely necessary before proceeding.
There is no way to migrate other clones automatically.

errors.msg: Nothing specified, nothing added.  hint: Maybe you wanted to say 'git add .'?
errors.why: git add ran with no paths, so it had nothing to stage.

fix.n: Stages everything under the current directory.
Or stage selectively, hunk by hunk.

errors.msg: no changes added to commit  Untracked files: <file>
errors.why: Untracked files are never committed implicitly, not even with commit -a.

fix.n: Track it first.
The -a flag covers tracked modifications only, which is the trap here.

errors.msg: fatal: You have nothing to amend.
errors.why: There is no previous commit on this branch to amend.

fix.n: Make the first commit; amend needs one to modify.
Confirms whether the branch has any history at all.

errors.msg: fatal: Failed to resolve 'HEAD' as a valid ref.
errors.why: The branch has no commits, so HEAD points at nothing to reset to.

fix.n: Unstage without needing HEAD when the repository is empty.
Or create the first commit so HEAD exists.

errors.msg: error: short object ID <hash> is ambiguous
errors.why: The abbreviated hash matches more than one object.

fix.n: Lists every object with that prefix.
Use more characters; seven is no longer always enough in large repositories.

errors.msg: fatal: invalid reference: <branch>
errors.why: The branch named for the new worktree does not exist.

fix.n: Create the branch as part of adding the worktree.
Or fetch the branch first if it lives on the remote.

errors.msg: fatal: <hash>: cannot cherry-pick a root commit without --allow-empty
errors.why: The commit has no parent, so there is no diff to apply.

fix.n: Records it even though it introduces nothing here.
Merging is usually what you meant when joining separate histories.

errors.msg: warning: skipped previously applied commit <hash>
errors.why: The commit's change is already present upstream, so the rebase dropped it.

fix.n: Keeps the duplicates if you genuinely want them replayed.
Confirms which of your commits still add something.

errors.msg: fatal: Could not find merge strategy '<name>'.
errors.why: The strategy name is misspelled or unavailable in this Git version.

fix.n: ort is the modern default strategy.
Strategy options use -X; the strategy itself uses -s.

errors.msg: error: while searching for:  error: patch fragment without header at line <n>
errors.why: The patch file is truncated or was mangled by copy and paste.

fix.n: Validates the file without touching the tree.
Regenerate the patch rather than repairing pasted text.

errors.msg: 5.7.8 Username and Password not accepted
errors.why: The SMTP server rejected the credentials, commonly because an app password is required.

fix.n: Set the account explicitly.
Most providers refuse ordinary account passwords for SMTP.

errors.msg: Automatic notes merge failed. Fix conflicts in .git/NOTES_MERGE_WORKTREE
errors.why: Two sides added notes to the same object.

fix.n: Finish after resolving the files in that worktree.
Or back out and keep your local notes.

errors.msg: warning: object <hash> is replaced by <other>
errors.why: A replace ref is rewriting history on the fly, which can be baffling if you did not create it.

fix.n: Lists active replacements.
Remove it, or pass --no-replace-objects to ignore replacements for one command.

errors.msg: fatal: No web server found
errors.why: git instaweb needs a local web server it could not locate.

fix.n: Use a server that exists on the machine.
The terminal history view needs nothing extra.

errors.msg: fatal: operation not supported by protocol  (git archive --remote)
errors.why: The server does not allow remote archiving.

fix.n: Clone shallowly, then archive locally.

fix.c: Download the ZIP from the repository page
fix.n: GitHub offers the same result through the web interface.

errors.msg: fatal: remote error: You can't push to git://github.com/<owner>/<repo>.git
errors.why: The git protocol is read-only; pushes need HTTPS or SSH.

fix.n: Switch to a writable protocol.
Confirms both fetch and push URLs were updated.

errors.msg: fatal: repository '<url>' not found  (plain file server)
errors.why: The URL serves files but is not a Git endpoint.

fix.n: Some plain servers work when you point at the .git directory.
Dumb HTTP is slow, fragile, and unsupported for pushing.

errors.msg: fatal: unable to connect to cache daemon
errors.why: The credential cache helper is configured but its daemon is not running.

fix.n: Switch to a helper that needs no daemon.
Or reset the daemon and let it restart.

errors.msg: error: storing password in keychain failed
errors.why: The macOS keychain is locked or denied access to Git.

fix.n: Unlock it, then retry the operation.
Confirms Git is using the keychain helper at all.

errors.msg: remote: Invalid username or password.  (after rotating a token)
errors.why: The credential store still holds the previous token.

fix.n: Clears the stored entry so the next push prompts.
Delete the git:https://github.com entry by hand if needed.

errors.msg: warning: <path> is a git repository, but not a submodule
errors.why: A nested repository exists where a submodule is expected.

fix.n: Moves the inner .git into the parent's modules folder.
Or register it properly as a submodule.

errors.msg: This repository is configured for Git LFS but 'git-lfs' was not found on your path
errors.why: A clone carries LFS configuration on a machine where LFS is missing.

fix.n: Installs the hooks and filters for your user.
Then fetch the real file contents.

errors.msg: Error: working copy must not be dirty
errors.why: LFS migration rewrites history and refuses to run over uncommitted work.

fix.n: Shelve everything first.
Then migrate on a clean tree.

errors.msg: Error: Could not parse mailmap line
errors.why: The mailmap file used during a rewrite has a malformed entry.

fix.n: Each line follows this shape exactly.
Tests a single entry before running the rewrite.

errors.msg: fatal: gc is already running  (during a fetch)
errors.why: Background maintenance is holding the repository while another command wants it.

fix.n: Disables automatic gc when it keeps colliding with scripts.
Or move maintenance to a schedule so it never runs mid-command.

errors.msg: warning: commit-graph has incorrect fanout value
errors.why: The cached graph disagrees with the objects, usually after an interrupted write.

fix.n: Safe to delete: it is a cache.
Rebuild it cleanly.

errors.msg: error: multi-pack-index checksum does not match
errors.why: The multi-pack index is damaged and must be regenerated.

fix.n: Another cache, safe to remove.
Rebuild it, or let maintenance do so on schedule.

errors.msg: warning: core.fsmonitor is set but the daemon is unavailable
errors.why: The filesystem monitor is enabled but cannot run in this environment.

fix.n: Turn it off where it is unsupported, such as some network shares.
Reports whether the daemon is healthy.

errors.msg: warning: untracked cache is disabled on this system or location
errors.why: The filesystem does not report directory changes reliably enough to cache them.

fix.n: Stop asking for it on that filesystem.
Tests whether the location supports it at all.

errors.msg: The pattern does not match because of a trailing space
errors.why: Trailing spaces are significant in .gitignore unless escaped.

fix.n: Shows whether any rule matches at all.
Strip trailing whitespace from the file.

errors.msg: The attribute has no effect on files already committed
errors.why: Attribute changes apply on the next checkout or after renormalising.

fix.n: Rewrites stored content under the new attributes.
Shows which attributes actually apply to a path.

errors.msg: error: unable to write file <path>: Text file busy
errors.why: The file is currently executing, so it cannot be replaced.

fix.n: Then retry the checkout.
Confirms which paths could not be written.

errors.msg: error: unable to write sha1 file: Disk quota exceeded
errors.why: The account or volume ran out of space mid-operation.

fix.n: Confirms the space situation.
Reclaims space inside the repository once there is room to work.

errors.msg: error: unable to create directory for <path>: Read-only file system
errors.why: The checkout location cannot be written to.

fix.n: Confirms the mount is read-only.
Work somewhere writable instead.

errors.msg: The rename was not recorded because only the case changed
errors.why: A case-insensitive filesystem reports no change, so Git records nothing.

fix.n: Tells Git explicitly, which records the rename.
Only on repositories that must stay case-exact.

errors.msg: Reinitialized existing Git repository in <path>
errors.why: Not an error: git init ran where a repository already exists and only refreshed it.

fix.n: Your history is intact; nothing was reset.
Confirms which repository you are actually in.

errors.msg: fatal: not a git repository: '<path>'  (GIT_DIR is set)
errors.why: A stale GIT_DIR or GIT_WORK_TREE variable is pointing Git somewhere else.

fix.n: Shows the variables in force for this shell.
Clear them, then run the command again.
